classification: AI-generated concept imagery, not photographs of actual business creations

records.name: golden-birthday
records.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a single standalone photorealistic cake photograph for a premium boutique bakery website concept. This is an illustrative concept image, not documentation of any real bakery's work.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory plaster seamless background, pale beige stone table or low plinth, completely uncluttered.
Style/medium: exceptionally high-resolution real editorial food and product photography. Natural edible frosting and hand-finished texture; no CGI, plastic, illustration or exaggerated styling.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 composition, use the highest native resolution available. Front three-quarter view at cake level, entire cake and its simple elegant stand visible, cake centred with generous breathing room above the topper, below the stand and on both sides for responsive website crops. Cake fills about 65 percent of the frame height.
Lighting/mood: soft directional daylight from the left, subtle natural shadows, rich but gentle tonal detail. The entire cake, decorations and frosting are tack-sharp; background softness only. Warm ivory, restrained blush and muted gold styling.
Constraints: one cake in one photograph, no collage, no surrounding props, no flowers unless explicitly requested in the subject, no humans or hands, no cut slices, no text, letters, numerals, monograms, brands, logos or watermarks.
Subject: one refined single-tier ivory birthday cake on a low ivory ceramic stand. A petite, delicately crafted gold sugar crown sits on top. Smooth ivory buttercream has subtle vertical spatula texture, fine scattered edible gold leaf accents and an understated tiny piped pearl border at the base. The crown is tasteful and realistic, not oversized. No flowers, number toppers or additional decorations.
